description: Get ticker information for one or more asset pairs. When no pair is given, returns tickers for all known pairs.

pair.description: Optional comma-separated list of asset pairs (canonical name or altname, e.g. 'XBTUSD' or 'XBTUSD,ETHUSD'). When omitted, all pairs are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output maps each canonical pair to its ticker data (ask, bid, last, volume, high, low, open); on failure (unknown asset pair), output contains an error message.

description: Get OHLC (open/high/low/close) candlestick data for a single asset pair.

pair.description: The asset pair (canonical name or altname, e.g. 'XBTUSD') to fetch candles for.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output maps the canonical pair to a list of candle rows (time, open, high, low, close, vwap, volume, count) plus a 'last' timestamp; on failure (unknown asset pair), output contains an error message.

description: List tradable asset pairs and their trading parameters, optionally filtered by pair.

pair.description: Optional comma-separated list of asset pairs (canonical name or altname) to filter by. When omitted, all pairs are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output maps each canonical pair to its details (altname, wsname, base, quote, pair_decimals, lot_decimals, ordermin, status); on failure (unknown asset pair), output contains an error message.

description: List asset (currency) reference information, optionally filtered by asset.

asset.description: Optional comma-separated list of assets (canonical name or altname, e.g. 'XBT,ETH') to filter by. When omitted, all assets are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output maps each canonical asset to its details (aclass, altname, decimals, display_decimals); on failure (unknown asset), output contains an error message.

description: Get the current account balances for all held assets.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output maps each asset to its balance string.
